headlines.title: 李 “골 깊으면 산 높을것 ” 증시 정상화 개혁기구 지시
headlines.summary: 빨간 넥타이 매고 한국거래소 찾아 이재명 대통령이 13일 서울 영등포구 한국거래소에서 열린 ‘자본시장 정책 간담회’에서 발언하고 있다. 취임 후 두 번째로 거래소를 찾은 이 대통령은 이날 간담회에서 “자본시장 정상화는 우리 정부의 확고한 정책 방향이고 의지”라고 밝혔다. 김재명 기자 base@donga.

headlines.title: 월급방위대 본격 가동 …월세·근로장려금 늘리고 돌봄·자산형성 지원
headlines.summary: 권대영 1차관 주재 범정부 TF 킥오프…11~12월 집중 운영 생계비·자녀 및 부모 돌봄·자산형성·일자리·건강관리 5대 분야 [세종=이데일리 김미영 기자] 직장인들의 생활비 부담을 낮추고 실질적인 가처분소득을 늘리기 위한 정부의 ‘월급방위대’가 본격 가동됐다.

headlines.summary: 정부, 3차 주택공급 정례브리핑 "서울 상승률 둔화·매물 증가세" 토허제 연장 관련 "모니터링 중" 12일 서울 시내 한 부동산에 전세 및 매매 등 매물 정보가 게시되어 있다. 뉴스1 정부가 서울 아파트 매매가격 상승세가 둔화하고 매물이 늘어나는 등 부동산 시장의 하향 안정 흐름을 보여주는 지표가 확대되고 있다고 진단했다.

headlines.title: [단독] " 보증금 없이 월세만 " 日기업 한국 상륙
headlines.summary: 월세시장 지각변동 일본 임대료 보증업체 제이리스 韓 진출 임박 세입자는 신용심사 받는 대신 목돈 부담 덜어 전세에서 월세로 빠르게 바뀌고 있는 한국 임대차 시장에 일본식 월세 보증 서비스가 상륙할 전망이다. 임차인의 월세 지급 능력을 심사해 보증을 서고 월세가 밀리면 보증회사가 임대인에게 대신 지급하는 방식이다.

headlines.title: ‘ AI 중앙은행 ’ 이끌었는데 … 순환거래 생태계 ‘ 돈맥경화 ’ 우려

headlines.title: 반도체 메가프로젝트 전력 · 용수 에 10년간 84조…국고만 58조

headlines.title: 구글 고정밀 지도 반출 조건 충족… 내년 초 국내 지도 시장 경쟁 본격화
headlines.summary: 정부, 고정밀 지도 반출 보안조건 이행 확인 티맵과 데이터 가공 협력… 내년 초 길찾기 기능 강화 국내 지도업계, 공정경쟁·서비스 고도화 강조 정부가 13일 구글의 고정밀 지도 국외 반출 보안조건 이행을 확인하면서 이르면 내년 초 구글의 국내 지도 서비스가 강화될 것으로 전망된다. 사진은 영국 런던의 구글 사무실 외부에 설치된 로고.

headlines.title: 20년 만에 '구글지도' 국외반출 허용
headlines.summary: 내년 구글 길찾기·내비 서비스 정부가 구글에 1 대 5000 축척 고정밀 지도의 국외 반출을 허용했다. 이에 따라 이르면 내년부터 국내에서도 구글 지도의 길 찾기와 내비게이션 서비스를 이용할 수 있을 것으로 전망된다. 국토교통부와 관계부처, 민간 전문가로 구성된 ‘기본측량성과 국외반출 협의체’는 13일 구글의 보안 조건 이행 결과를 최종 승인했다.

headlines.title: ‘민원 예산’ 전락할라… 너도나도 숟가락 얹는 미래기금

headlines.title: 젠슨 황 , 33년 만에 불명예 퇴진 …직원들 눈물, 본사엔 꽃다발

key_headlines.title: Government Allocates 84 Trillion Won Over 10 Years for Semiconductor Megaproject Infrastructure
key_headlines.summary: The government estimates that power and water infrastructure expansion needed for megaproject implementation will cost approximately 84 trillion won over the next decade, with 58 trillion won coming from the national budget. The Democratic Party's Mega Growth Special Committee received this report during a budget discussion meeting.

key_headlines.title: Japanese No-Deposit Monthly Rental Service Enters Korean Market
key_headlines.summary: Japan's deposit-free monthly rental guarantee company J.Lease is set to launch in Korea, offering tenants credit-based rental services without substantial upfront deposits. This service addresses Korea's rapid shift from deposit-heavy jeonse to monthly rental markets.

key_headlines.title: President Lee Declares Stock Market Normalization as Firm Government Policy
key_headlines.summary: President Lee Lee-myung visited the Korea Exchange and emphasized that capital market normalization is an unwavering policy direction and commitment of his administration. He instructed the establishment of a stock market reform task force to restore market confidence.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches Wage Defense Program to Increase Disposable Income
key_headlines.summary: The government's 'Wage Defense Program' has begun full operation, focusing on five areas including increased monthly rent support, expanded earned income tax credits, childcare and elderly care support, job creation, and health management services during November and December.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Housing Market Shows Stabilization Signs with Declining Price Growth and Rising Inventory
key_headlines.summary: The government reported that Seoul apartment price increases are slowing and inventory is rising, indicating a downward stabilization trend in the real estate market. The government plans to supply approximately 44,000 units in the Seoul metropolitan area by the first quarter of next year.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean government is undertaking major economic initiatives to support workers and stabilize key markets. The megaproject semiconductor infrastructure investment of 84 trillion won over a decade represents a significant commitment to industrial capacity. The government's Wage Defense Program aims to ease living costs through increased rent support and expanded welfare benefits. Seoul's real estate market shows emerging stabilization signals with moderating price growth and increased property listings. Additionally, the government is working to normalize stock market operations through comprehensive institutional reforms.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Korea's economy continues to show steady growth with employment gains and moderate inflation management. October employment increased by 139,000 persons year-over-year with unemployment at 2.0%, down 0.2 percentage points annually. Consumer price inflation moderated to 2.8% in October from 2.9% in September, though energy and processed food prices remain elevated. The Bank of Korea faces decisions on additional interest rate hikes amid persistent inflationary pressures. The government held an economic situation briefing to discuss price management strategies amid rising oil and food costs.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean stock markets showed volatile trading with KOSPI and KOSDAQ opening higher but retreating to flat or slightly negative territory during the day. KOSPI failed to sustain the 5,300 level amid AI investment sentiment weakness and international market concerns. The Won-Dollar exchange rate traded around 1,334.3 won as investors remained cautious about global economic signals. Market sentiment has been affected by concerns about AI investment sustainability and international monetary policy directions.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korean companies are making significant advances in battery and AI semiconductor technologies. Samsung SDI secured a multi-trillion won ESS battery supply contract with Jupiter Power for lithium iron phosphate batteries. Korean companies are expanding into physical AI robotics markets, with firms developing precision motor control semiconductors for autonomous systems. Battery technology innovations including nano-coating for graphite anodes are enabling extended charge cycles and improved longevity for electric vehicles and energy storage systems.
sections.Real Estate: The Seoul housing market is experiencing stabilization with declining price growth rates and increasing property listings for sale. Incheon, the only Seoul metropolitan area city showing price declines, paradoxically faces surging jeonse prices due to low purchasing expectations and reduced rental inventory. GS Construction opened a sales office for the Armujejai project in Ansan on 880,000 square meters of former Home Plus property with 1,354 units. Government policies continue to support housing supply with plans to deliver 44,000 units in the Seoul metropolitan area by Q1 2025, addressing both affordability and market stabilization concerns.
sections.International Economy: Nine countries including the US, Korea, and Japan are coordinating to strengthen AI supply chain defense against China's influence. Global automakers face growing dilemmas as they expand Chinese partnerships for cost competitiveness while navigating US and European origin and supply chain regulations. The Yuan faces IMF assessments of up to 25% undervaluation while European concerns about currency weakness threatening industries clash with Chinese corporate worries about revenue impacts from appreciation. Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia has sparked 670 trillion won in AI finance sector instability amid concerns about investment sustainability in data center infrastructure.
sections.AI & Economy: Korean companies are capitalizing on robust AI and data center demand from North America. Daehan Optical Communications achieved consecutive quarterly operating profits with 39.3% revenue growth driven by AI data center supplies to North America. LG U+ is developing AI token cost optimization technology reducing enterprise operational expenses by up to 90% to accelerate corporate AI market entry. Eden T&S emphasizes that enterprise-specific data and operational systems provide sustainable competitive advantages beyond vendor-dependent AI models. However, global AI investment enthusiasm is waning with 560 trillion won in market capitalization evaporated from data center infrastructure-related stocks since June as investor confidence weakens.
sections.Others: The industrial workforce authority launched comprehensive investigations into AI cheating incidents during the certified tax accountant examination and plans to pursue criminal charges and cancel qualifications. The government faces budget pressures with cigarette tax revenues declining 27.6% despite unchanged tax rates since 2015, complicating funding for emergency services and public housing. Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee is attending the Financial Stability Board annual meeting in Europe to discuss international cooperation on AI and stablecoin regulation while supporting Korean financial institutions' overseas expansion.
